implementation_statement: POL-02 (P06), which includes the program governance section, was approved 2026-08-31 and takes effect 2026-09-01. Before that the farm had no written security policy. A one-page account procedure (onboarding, season start, season end, and departure checklist) is due 2026-09-30.

provider_if_inherited: FMIS vendor; productivity suite vendor; MSP
implementation_statement: The Office Manager asks the MSP to create productivity suite accounts; the Irrigation and Equipment Technician creates SYS-01 accounts from the vendor's role list (manager, operator, crew). Gaps: no departure checklist (a former bookkeeper's mailbox stayed active with a forwarding rule from January to 2026-07-21); one shared 'field crew' SYS-01 login; no account review.
evidence: EV-003 (SYS-01 user list); EV-007 (productivity suite user export); EV-042 (former bookkeeper account); EV-031 (departure checklist)

implementation_statement: SYS-01 enforces its roles: the crew role can enter hours and records but cannot change irrigation. Gap: the Office folder (payroll exports, H-2A passport and visa copies) is shared with all four office users, including the Irrigation and Equipment Technician, who does not need it.
evidence: EV-003 (SYS-01 role list); EV-008 (Office folder sharing report)

implementation_statement: Users have no local administrator rights on the laptops (MSP policy). Gaps: the Office Manager kept local administrator rights on the desktop after the irrigation dealer installed pump station software in 2024, and both the Owner and General Manager and the Technician hold SYS-01 administrator roles.
evidence: EV-010 (MSP endpoint policy report); EV-036 (local administrator rights since 2024); EV-003 (SYS-01 role list)

implementation_statement: SYS-01 and the productivity suite lock an account after repeated failed sign-ins (vendor settings).
evidence: EV-004 (SYS-01 lockout setting); EV-038 (vendor documentation); EV-052 (FMIS vendor SOC 2 report)

implementation_statement: The desktop and laptops lock after 15 minutes (MSP policy). Gap: the shared field tablet has no screen lock, so anyone who picks it up is signed in to SYS-01 as the field crew.
evidence: EV-010 (MSP endpoint policy report); EV-045 (tablet check 2026-07-22)

implementation_statement: Remote access types are not documented or authorized. The irrigation dealer reaches the pump station controller through an always-on cellular gateway with one shared dealer login and no MFA; the MSP uses its remote management tool on the office computers; the equipment dealer has standing diagnostic access to the telematics account. Redesign to on-request access is in POAM-002.
evidence: EV-020 (dealer reply on remote access); EV-AC-17 (gateway configuration viewed with the dealer); EV-017 (MSP contract); EV-021 (telematics portal user list)

implementation_statement: The shop Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a shared password. Gaps: the password has not changed since 2022, it is known to dealer technicians and contractors, and there is no separate guest network.

No security awareness training. Produce Safety training at hire (English and Spanish) does not cover security. Annual training with a Spanish version and short phishing tips starts 2026-11-30 (POAM-012).

provider_if_inherited: FMIS vendor; productivity suite vendor; MSP
implementation_statement: SYS-01 keeps an audit trail of record edits and irrigation commands; the productivity suite logs sign-ins and file activity; the firewall keeps about 7 days of logs. Gap: the pump station controller and gateway keep no log the farm can read.
evidence: EV-004 (SYS-01 audit trail settings); EV-047 (audit trail sample); EV-007 (suite audit settings); EV-014 (firewall log settings)

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: Nobody reviews SYS-01, productivity suite, or firewall logs. A 30-minute monthly review with a checklist (sign-ins, forwarding rules, SYS-01 irrigation changes and record edits) starts 2026-10-31.
An independent consultant assessed 13 controls from 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-13 (P07). POL-02 A.6 requires an assessment each year by someone who does not operate the controls.
The MSP keeps a copy of the firewall configuration and its standard laptop image. Gap: no recorded baseline for the pump station controller, the gateway, or the pivot panel settings.
evidence: EV-014 (MSP firewall configuration backup); EV-010 (MSP standard image)

implementation_statement: No change control. The irrigation dealer changes the pump station program remotely without telling the farm, and pivot settings change in SYS-01 without a record of why. A change log approved by the Technician starts 2026-10-31.

No inventory of devices, OT, software, or where personal data lives. A one-page inventory (8 IT devices, about 30 OT and IoT devices, 7 SaaS services, and the personal data in each) is due 2026-10-31.

No contingency plan and no written manual irrigation procedure. A short plan built from the BIA (P05), with the hand-operation procedure, paper forms, and a hurricane checklist, is due 2027-01-31 (POAM-004).
No restore test or exercise has ever been done. First SYS-08 restore test due 2026-09-30; hand-operation drill with a second person before the 2027 season; annual tabletop using the P08 runbook.
evidence: EV-015 (no restore jobs); EV-CP-4 (MSP confirmation that no restore test exists)

implementation_statement: The MSP backs up the productivity suite nightly to SYS-08 (30 days of versions). The FMIS vendor backs up SYS-01. Gaps: SYS-08 is not immutable and is administered with one password-only account; SYS-01 has never been exported; the pump station program exists only on the dealer's laptop.
evidence: EV-CP-9 (SYS-08 job report, July 2026, and retention settings); EV-015 (SYS-08 settings at intake)

implementation_statement: Office users have named accounts in SYS-01 and the productivity suite. Gap: the crew enters daily hours and Produce Safety records under one shared 'field crew' login, so entries are not tied to the person who did the work.
evidence: EV-003 (SYS-01 user list); EV-047 (sample of 20 records)

provider_if_inherited: Productivity suite vendor; FMIS vendor; MSP
implementation_statement: MFA is enforced for productivity suite administrators and on the Owner and General Manager's SYS-01 account. Gaps: the Technician's SYS-01 administrator account (which can start and stop pivots) has no MFA, and the MSP's SYS-08 administrator account and the dealer's gateway login have none.
evidence: EV-007 (suite MFA settings); EV-004 (SYS-01 security settings); EV-IA-2(1) (P07 test 2026-08-12)

implementation_statement: Users choose their own passwords; the productivity suite requires 12 characters. Gaps: the pump station touchscreen still uses the default PIN; the gateway accepted the manufacturer default password until 2026-08-14; the shop Wi-Fi password is unchanged since 2022.
evidence: EV-IA-5 (P07 tests); EV-050 (gateway password change record)

implementation_statement: POL-03 approved 2026-08-31, effective 2026-09-01. No incident procedure existed before.
The P08 ransomware runbook was approved 2026-08-31, with the MSP and the cyber insurer's hotline in the chain. Not yet tested; the first tabletop is due 2026-11-30.
Staff have not been told how or when to report an incident. A reporting card in English and Spanish and a briefing are due 2026-10-31 (POAM-013).
The runbook and notification matrix (P08) are the farm's incident response plan. Printed copies go in the office and the pump station by 2026-09-30.

The irrigation dealer's remote maintenance of the pump station is not approved, monitored, or recorded, and the session path is always on. Sessions on request only, approved by the Technician and logged, from 2026-10-31.
evidence: EV-019 (dealer service invoices, 9 remote sessions in 2026); EV-MA-4 (sessions not approved by the farm)

implementation_statement: No disposal procedure or records. The old office desktop was given to a relative in 2025 without a recorded wipe.
The farm office is locked when unattended and the pump station panel is padlocked. Gap: the River Tract pivot panels are in open fields with no locks on the cabinet doors.
This plan, approved 2026-08-31.
Workforce use rules are in POL-02 Part C (approved 2026-08-31). Signed acknowledgments in English and Spanish are due 2026-09-30.

baseline: Not in Moderate baseline (selected by tailoring)
implementation_statement: The Owner and General Manager designated the Office Manager as Security Coordinator in writing on 2026-08-31 (POL-02 A.1), about 3 hours a week.

Departures are handled when someone remembers. A last-day checklist covering SYS-01, the suite, the telematics portal, shared passwords, and devices is due 2026-09-30. H-2A workers have no accounts, but the shared field login must change each season end.
First documented risk assessment completed 2026-07-31 using NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (P01); approved 2026-08-31. Annual update each July (POL-02 A.2).

No vulnerability scanning. The MSP will scan the office computers and the firewall quarterly from 2026-12-31; the pump station and gateway get an annual passive review with the dealer, not active scans.

The farm relies on the FMIS vendor, the productivity suite vendor, the MSP, the irrigation dealer, the equipment dealer, the payroll service, the H-2A filing agent, and the AI vendor. Gaps: no security terms with the irrigation dealer, the equipment dealer, or the AI vendor; no breach contact registered with the payroll service or the filing agent; the FMIS vendor's SOC 2 report was first requested in August 2026.
evidence: EV-048 (contract folder review); EV-052 (FMIS vendor SOC 2 report); P09 vendor report review

implementation_statement: The MSP-managed firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic. Gaps: one flat network for the office desktop, Wi-Fi, and pump station; the dealer's cellular gateway bypasses the firewall entirely; its admin page was reachable from the internet until 2026-08-14.

provider_if_inherited: FMIS vendor; productivity suite vendor; cellular carrier
implementation_statement: SaaS traffic uses TLS. Pivot commands travel over the carrier's private cellular network to the pivot manufacturer's service. The pump station bridge uses WPA2 encryption.

SaaS vendors encrypt stored data; the MSP encrypts both laptops. Gaps: the office desktop holding the synced H-2A files is unencrypted, and the field tablet has no screen lock, so its built-in encryption gives no protection.
The MSP patches the desktop and laptops monthly. Gaps: the pump station controller and gateway firmware have never been updated; tablets and phones update only when users accept prompts.
evidence: EV-SI-2 (MSP patch report, July 2026, and gateway firmware version); EV-012 (MSP monthly report)

implementation_statement: The MSP runs antivirus on the desktop and laptops. Gap: alerts reach the MSP only during business hours, and there is no behavior-based detection.

No monitoring. SYS-01 can alert on pivot starts, stops, and schedule changes, but the alerts are switched off. Turning them on (to the Technician's and the Owner and General Manager's phones) is due 2026-09-30.

SYS-01 keeps records indefinitely. Gap: no retention schedule; Produce Safety records must be kept at least 2 years (21 CFR 112.164(a)(1)) and H-2A earnings records at least 3 years (20 CFR 655.122(j)(4)). Schedule due 2026-12-31 (POL-04 4.8).
